stem.en: A metal spoon and a wooden spoon have been sitting in the same room for hours, so they are at the same temperature. Why does the metal spoon feel colder to touch?
stem.et: Metallist lusikas ja puust lusikas on olnud samas toas tunde, seega on nende temperatuur sama. Miks tundub metallist lusikas puudutades külmem?

label.en: Because it has a lower temperature than the wooden spoon
label.et: Sest selle temperatuur on madalam kui puust lusikal

label.en: Because it conducts heat away from your hand faster
label.et: Sest see juhib soojust käest kiiremini ära

label.en: Because metal is naturally colder than wood
label.et: Sest metall on loomuomaselt puidust külmem

label.en: Because wood generates its own heat
